gates.unit: node --test tests/scrape-pursuit.test.mjs, the named test and no other

unit.name: the family stops at its first stop and never goes on to the next
unit.expect: the family chooses where it goes and by which way, with stops, and changes it on the road; the train goes as one
failed: the family chooses where it goes and by which way, with stops, and changes it on the road; the train goes as one

unit.name: a family across country seen from as far as on the road
unit.expect: the road is quicker; across country is slower by its going, a wagon cannot cross timber, and a family off the road is seen from half as far
failed: the road is quicker; across country is slower by its going, a wagon cannot cross timber, and a family off the road is seen from half as far

unit.name: the patrols out a day before the record has them
unit.expect: only a column on its dated road or a patrol out ahead of one can see a family, on the record's days
failed: only a column on its dated road or a patrol out ahead of one can see a family, on the record's days

unit.name: the order to halt in Spanish with no English under it
unit.expect: Mexican horsemen come on, order the family to halt in Spanish with the English under it, and a family that halts is taken without a shot
failed: Mexican horsemen come on, order the family to halt in Spanish with the English under it, and a family that halts is taken without a shot

unit.name: infantry faster than a family on foot
unit.expect: the chase goes at the record's paces: an ox wagon slower than infantry, a family on foot or on horseback faster, cavalry faster than all
failed: the chase goes at the record's paces: an ox wagon slower than infantry, a family on foot or on horseback faster, cavalry faster than all

unit.name: a running target as easy to hit as a still one
unit.expect: the shots are the researched table: by range, shooter and target, a moving target at six in ten, nothing past two hundred yards
failed: the shots are the researched table: by range, shooter and target, a moving target at six in ten, nothing past two hundred yards

unit.name: a lamed ox pulls at its full pace
unit.expect: a beast hit slows the train: a lamed ox halves the wagon's pace, and an ox shot down leaves a running family on foot
failed: a beast hit slows the train: a lamed ox halves the wagon's pace, and an ox shot down leaves a running family on foot

unit.name: the horsemen follow a family into the timber
unit.expect: they give up at the timber, after their miles, and at dark; they take a family they come up with
failed: they give up at the timber, after their miles, and at dark; they take a family they come up with

unit.name: another family sent the first family's route
unit.expect: the class's clock is held to the chase only for a family at its screen, and the chase is its own and the Host's to see, with its route its own alone
failed: the class's clock is held to the chase only for a family at its screen, and the chase is its own and the Host's to see, with its route its own alone

unit.name: the save version moved
unit.expect: an old save opens: a flight with no route, no chase, no path fields validates and runs, and no save version moved
failed: an old save opens: a flight with no route, no chase, no path fields validates and runs, and no save version moved

unit.name: the children among the targets
unit.expect: children are never hit, and most shots miss: the soldiers aim at the grown people, the animals and the wagon
failed: children are never hit, and most shots miss: the soldiers aim at the grown people, the animals and the wagon

unit.name: an absent family's chase holds the class
expect: the class's clock is held to the chase only for a family at its screen, and the chase is its own and the Host's to see, with its route its own alone
an automatic family halts when it is ordered to, and an order nobody answers halts the family; both written down
failed: an automatic family halts when it is ordered to, and an order nobody answers halts the family; both written down
the class's clock is held to the chase only for a family at its screen, and the chase is its own and the Host's to see, with its route its own alone

unit.name: an automatic family's halt written as a student's answer
unit.expect: an automatic family halts when it is ordered to, and an order nobody answers halts the family; both written down
failed: an automatic family halts when it is ordered to, and an order nobody answers halts the family; both written down

unit.name: the unanswered order answered as a choice, not a lapse
unit.expect: an automatic family halts when it is ordered to, and an order nobody answers halts the family; both written down
failed: an automatic family halts when it is ordered to, and an order nobody answers halts the family; both written down

browser.name: another family's map drew the first family's path
browser.expect: another family's map drew the first family's way
browser.failure: another family's map drew the first family's way

browser.name: the Host's map drew a family's path
browser.expect: the Host's map drew a family's way
browser.failure: the Host's map drew a family's way

browser.name: the orders never drawn over the horsemen
browser.expect: "¡Alto!" was not drawn over the horsemen
browser.failure: "¡Alto!" was not drawn over the horsemen

environment: Same computer: node --test, and a local classroom server with headless Chrome at 1366x768 and 1024x768.
